status: FROZEN before any answer-level feature is related to a label and before any rule is scored. Changes need an amendment written before the affected numbers are seen.
requested_by: Omri 2026-09-29/30: use the project's original answer-level detection (answers x features, label-free fusion) to decide whether and how many steps to flag in each answer; 'you can try both' = the original spectral features + continuous L-SML AND U-PCR on the full pool.
question: Does a label-free answer-level detector, fused from answer-level telemetry features, (a) separate erroneous from clean answers where the comparison is fair, and (b) improve the per-answer flag decision over the frozen rule R0 and over decision_rule_v1's R2, on PRMBench (official PRMScore) and ProcessBench (official F1)?
access: Development evidence on the already-evaluated population (13,769 answers). Not untouched confirmation. Labels enter only the evaluation. The step scores (S_equal, stage B) and their within-answer ranking are frozen; only the flag decision changes.

features.source: .worktrees/token-probability-fusion-v1/results/token_probability_fusion_v1/TOKEN_MATRICES.npz (per-token channels, token_offsets aligned with OOF_ANSWERS; teacher-forced one-pass telemetry already used by every stage)
features.pool_27: spectral_utils.feature_utils.extract_all_features on the per-token q15_H1 entropy series (the 16 FEAT_NAMES entropy features: epr, trace_length, spectral_entropy, low_band_power, high_band_power, hl_ratio, dominant_freq, spectral_centroid, stft_max_high_power, stft_spectral_entropy, rpdi, sw_var_peak, pe_mean, hurst_exponent, cusum_max, cusum_shift_idx) + compute_spilled_energy_features on chosen_surprisal (epr_spilled, sw_var_peak_spilled, cusum_max_spilled, min_spilled) + the same function on energy_level (epr_energy, sw_var_peak_energy, cusum_max_energy, min_energy) + answer means of q15_VE1 (varentropy), logprob_margin (logprob_margin), true_tail50 (tail50_mass)
features.adaptation: The canonical 30-view pool's mean_top1_logprob, mean_logprob_entropy and renyi_entropy_2 need the full top-k lists, which this token file does not hold; they are omitted. Tail mass is the top-50 tail (true_tail50), not the canonical top-5 tail. Labelled as an adaptation of the canonical pool, not the pool itself.
features.missing_values: a non-finite feature value is replaced by the median of that feature over the fit-fold answers of the same cell (label-free); counts reported

cells_and_folds: Fitting is per cell (the 8 ProcessBench cells and the PRMBench cell), as in the original answer-level work. For evaluation fold k: calibration fold c = (k+1)%5, fit folds = the other three. Every learned quantity for fold k uses only fit- or calibration-fold answers.

detectors.D1_upcr_full: Omri's method 2. U-PCR (spectral_utils.upcr.upcr_fit) with the maintained configuration of scripts/labelfree_standing_report.py (loss l2, exclusion on, difficulty_gate off, simple_avg_fallback on, recompute_after_exclusion on, g2_projection_k 1, scale_ratio 0.25) on the 27 z-scored views (fit-fold statistics), relative polarity derived from sign(rho) of a probe fit (upcr_pipeline_faithful 'derived' mode), weights applied to evaluation answers
detectors.D2_lsml_cont_good5: Omri's method 1, the original configuration: continuous L-SML (fusion_utils.lsml_continuous) on GOOD_5 = epr, low_band_power, sw_var_peak, cusum_max, spectral_entropy, oriented with FEATURE_SIGNS, z-scored with fit-fold statistics; the fitted linear weights (cross-group x within-group) applied to evaluation answers
detectors.D3_lsml_full: continuous L-SML on the same 27 views and polarities as D1 (L-SML vs equal on the same bank, Omri 2026-09-23)
detectors.D4_equal_full: plain average of the same 27 oriented z-scored views (control)
detectors.D5_epr: mean token entropy alone (the anchor; simplest reference)
detectors.global_sign: every detector is oriented on the fit-fold answers so that it correlates positively with epr (spectral_utils.streaming_utils.anchor_orient convention: higher mean entropy = more suspicious); the fit-fold decision is applied to evaluation answers

decision_rule.OFFSET (per detector): D_is = zA_i + answer-z(S)_is, where zA_i = (A_i - mean) / sd of the detector over the fit-fold answers of the cell. Flag step s of answer i iff D_is >= tau(k, b) = 0.8 quantile of D over the calibration-fold steps of the same benchmark b. Within an answer the order of flags is exactly the frozen ranking of S; only how many steps are flagged changes, and it can be zero. Weight 1:1 declared; weights 0.5 and 2 reported as descriptive sensitivity only.
decision_rule.SHUFFLED_A (control for D1 and D2): zA permuted among answers of the same cell, fold and step count (20 draws), then the same OFFSET rule: tests whether the answer's own level matters beyond length
decision_rule.references: R0 = frozen answer-z q80 (reproduces PRMScore 0.6565188557935739); R2 = decision_rule_v1 primary rule (reproduces 0.6635359749948694, PRMBench-calibrated as frozen); R2pb = R2 with its tau_G calibrated per benchmark (ProcessBench tau from ProcessBench calibration steps), because the new rules are calibrated per benchmark

primary_family: OFFSET(D1) - R0 and OFFSET(D2) - R0, each on PRMBench official PRMScore and on ProcessBench official F1 macro-8 (4 tests, Holm). Secondary: every rule vs R0 and vs R2/R2pb, D3 vs D4 (L-SML vs equal on the same bank).

endpoints.answer_level_detection: AUROC of each detector for 'answer contains an error' on evaluation answers: ProcessBench erroneous vs correct (per cell and macro); PRMBench erroneous (in-range error) vs multi_solutions (modified but correct) = the FAIR PRMBench comparison; PRMBench erroneous vs controls reported separately and labelled as confounded by original-vs-modified text
endpoints.prmbench: official PRMScore (6,211 answers), F1 on correct / error steps, flag share, share of erroneous answers with an error step flagged, clean-answer panel: multi_solutions vs erroneous share with at least one flag (length-matched as well), controls separately
endpoints.processbench: official F1 per cell and macro-8 (first flagged step or -1; F1 0 when both accuracies are 0), accuracy on erroneous and on correct answers, share of correct answers with no flag

uncertainty: paired bootstrap over source groups, 10,000 draws (PRMBench seed 20261011, ProcessBench seed 20261012); answer-level AUROC intervals by the same group bootstrap
hard_stops: token spans do not align with the OOF step structure (answer order, step counts)
R0 or R2 does not reproduce its frozen PRMScore to 1e-12
a U-PCR or L-SML fit fails, or a detector is non-finite on any evaluation answer
any fold-k quantity uses fold-k answers

predictions_frozen.P1: D1 separates erroneous from correct ProcessBench answers with macro AUROC >= 0.60
predictions_frozen.P2: on PRMBench the fair comparison (erroneous vs multi_solutions) is much weaker than erroneous vs controls
predictions_frozen.P3: OFFSET rules raise ProcessBench official F1 over R0 (answers left unflagged), D1 by more than D5 (epr alone)
predictions_frozen.P4: on PRMScore the OFFSET rules gain over R0 but not over R2
predictions_frozen.P5: D1 >= D2 on answer-level AUROC; D3 does not beat D4 (L-SML vs equal on the same bank)

not_done: no change to step scores, channels or their ranking; no threshold or quantile chosen from outcomes; no feature selected with labels; no new inference
